name: Zapier
tagline: Workflow automation with AI agents and chatbots
description: Zapier connects apps into automated workflows and offers AI agents and chatbots as add-ons, with plans measured in monthly tasks.
strengths: Free plan with 100 tasks per month
limitations: Prices rise with the task tier
Agent and chatbot add-ons are priced separately from the task pool

plans.name: Professional
plans.billing: From the 750-task tier; tiers run to 2,000,000 tasks per month

plans.name: Team
plans.billing: From the 2,000-task tier; tiers run to 2,000,000 tasks per month

pricing.trial: 14-day Professional trial for new accounts, no credit card required.

api.summary: AI add-ons are separate from the task pool: Agents (400 activities per month free, 1,500 on Pro, from about $33.33 per month billed annually) and Chatbots (2 free; about 5 at $13.33 or 20 at $66.67 per month billed annually).

pricing.regional: Prices are set in USD and can be billed in 19 local currencies; non-USD charges convert at the exchange rate at payment. Tax treatment: not stated.
